scope: Native FP16 FlashAttentionScore replay from fixed captured batch0, not historical FIA or a model-quality test

fixed_inputs.source: same real captured layer1 batch0 Q/K/V bytes
fixed_inputs.b8: repeat the same sequence eight times; do not use previous full B8 QKV as new input

primary_numeric_endpoint.values: private little-endian full batch0 FP16 output

secondary_endpoint: All native return tensors: metadata/SHA/statistics; FP32 softmax auxiliaries may change without a representable FP16 output change.
gates: all sixteen cells observed with distinct call identities
Q/K/V source bytes and every repeated input batch verified
same approved vendor/kernel source and precision/mask/scalars
actual typed raw matches launched raw, not desired profile alone
all target query/head legal keys exactly once and no query split across cores
repeat input/profile/raw/output values stable or report unstable, never deterministic attribution
attribution_boundaries: The joint change cannot identify M as root cause
An observed M intervention effect includes its legitimate dependent tiling changes; it is not proof of a unique micro-operation
Source-derived scheduling and grouped key ranges are not a hardware floating-point instruction trace
Identical legal key groups do not prove identical arithmetic; different host softmax metadata alone does not prove the kernel used it
If outputs all match, report no observed effect for this fixed input; do not fail or invent a fault
If repeats differ, keep observed differences but report NOT_IDENTIFIED_UNSTABLE_REPEATS
For M-only separate task assignment, computed masked ranges, legal key groups, BMM/Vec geometry and observed outputs
fixed_fp64_reference_note: Prespecified boundary queries; no post-result selection. FP64 is a numerical reference on represented FP16 inputs, not proof of historical fault or worse model quality.

secondary_policy_matrix.selection: Always scheduled after primary matrix independent of primary output differences
secondary_policy_matrix.claim_boundary: Controlled Batch-to-tiling selection only, not evidence of the original stock default or historical FIA defect

stock_bridge_calibration.actual_libraries: original native libraries without custom vendor
stock_bridge_calibration.gate: Every private BASE complete target output is bitwise equal to the same-batch repeated stock bridge output; actual native raw prefix must also match
stock_bridge_calibration.old_capture_binding: B8 target output equals original captured model layer1 OFF batch0 output; B1 comparison to old B8 is descriptive, not equality gate
stock_bridge_calibration.purpose: Separate replay/private OFF compatibility from any tiling intervention
